Alex / Samir — happy to take the technical lead on the PoC. I put together a short network and perf stub attached (network_requirements.pdf) with the minimum items your infra team will need. Summary:
- Outbound TLS from pilot host to Redwood inference endpoints (443) + allow responses; we'll provide a narrow set of IP ranges for egress (we can use our cloud provider ranges or a static set for Dedicated).
- Auth: API key (for PoC) followed by KMS integration if you move to private deployment.
- Expected throughput for PoC: 5 concurrent sessions, ~20 reqs/min, ~1.5MB/day sample payloads. If you expect significantly higher we should size accordingly.
- KV cache persistence: not required for PoC; we recommend using our prefix caching for latency-sensitive flows.

RACI confirmations from technical side:
- Redwood SE (Ben Carter) — Responsible for PoC delivery and integration checkpoints
